title: Turkish Kunefe with Cheese
description: A classic Turkish dessert made with crispy kunefe pastry, melted cheese, and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Cut the kunefe pastry into small pieces and place them in a bowl.
Add the unsalted butter to the bowl and mix until the pastry is well-coated.
In a separate bowl, mix the kashkaval cheese with the granulated sugar.
Add the cheese mixture to the pastry bowl and mix until well combined.
Grease a baking dish with butter and arrange the pastry mixture in an even layer.
Bake the kunefe in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the kunefe from the oven and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.
Drizzle with rose water, if using.
